selected_evidence.requirement: opsadmin account and requested SSH key
selected_evidence.summary: Confirms the account, exact authorized-key text and fingerprint, ownership, and restrictive permissions before and after restart.
Effective sshd policy requires publickey, disables password and keyboard-interactive methods, and password-only probes are rejected with Permission denied (publickey).

Captures healthy baseline boot ID 254597f8-4ac9-4062-8be8-44eba1f6d2e9, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID f25be7b9-0e16-4219-b803-bee2d9c17968, and recovered system, sshd listener, account, key, and authentication policy.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf '%s\n' '--- os ---'
cat /etc/os-release
printf '%s\n' '--- user ---'
if id opsadmin >/dev/null 2>&1; then id opsadmin; getent passwd opsadmin; else printf '%s\n' 'opsadmin: absent'; fi
printf '%s\n' '--- ssh service/listener ---'
systemctl is-active sshd || true
systemctl is-enabled sshd || true
ss -tlnp | awk 'NR==1 || /:22[[:space:]]/'
printf '%s\n' '--- effective ssh auth config ---'
sshd -T 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^(pubkeyauthentication|passwordauthentication|kbdinteractiveauthentication|authenticationmethods|permitrootlogin|authorizedkeysfile) ' || true

commands.command:
set -eu
if ! id opsadmin >/dev/null 2>&1; then useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash opsadmin; fi
install -d -m 0700 -o opsadmin -g opsadmin /home/opsadmin/.ssh
printf '%s\n' 'ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAINMKA2+oNHxgmpABaV61Sar8lVW2YxSL8Aw9d7b5yLh1 os-comparison@example.invalid' > /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
chown opsadmin:opsadmin /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
chmod 0600 /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
restorecon -RF /home/opsadmin/.ssh >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
id opsadmin
stat -c '%U:%G %a %n' /home/opsadmin /home/opsadmin/.ssh /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys
ssh-keygen -lf /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys

commands.command:
set -eu
grep -nE '^[[:space:]]*(Include|PasswordAuthentication|KbdInteractiveAuthentication|PubkeyAuthentication|AuthenticationMethods)[[:space:]]' /etc/ssh/sshd_config || true
printf '%s\n' '--- drop-ins ---'
find /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f\n' | sort
for f in /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/*.conf; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; printf '%s\n' "--- $f"; grep -nE '^[[:space:]]*(PasswordAuthentication|KbdInteractiveAuthentication|PubkeyAuthentication|AuthenticationMethods)[[:space:]]' "$f" || true; done

set -eu
printf '%s
' 'PubkeyAuthentication yes' 'PasswordAuthentication no' 'KbdInteractiveAuthentication no' 'AuthenticationMethods publickey' > /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/10-opsadmin-key-only.conf
chmod 0600 /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/10-opsadmin-key-only.conf
restorecon /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/10-opsadmin-key-only.conf >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
sshd -t
systemctl reload sshd
systemctl is-active sshd
sshd -T -C user=opsadmin,host="$NODE_NAME",addr="$NODE_IP" | grep -E '^(pubkeyauthentication|passwordauthentication|kbdinteractiveauthentication|authenticationmethods|authorizedkeysfile) '
